purpose.primary: Provide a small formal teaching abstraction inspired by the triadic structural organization present in TFT.
purpose.formal_goal: Represent a generic three-position structure and inspect component-wise mapping, identity, composition, and structural persistence.
purpose.educational_principle: Formalize the smallest useful structure first, and preserve the boundary between that abstraction and the broader source framework.

source_alignment.source_concept: TFT contains recurring triadic organization, operators, mathematical notation, recursion, and broader exploratory interpretations.
source_alignment.selected_structure: Three distinguishable positions treated as a generic triad.

not_formalized_here: empirical claims associated with broader TFT material
abstraction_boundary.principle: The formal artifact is deliberately much smaller than its project-lineage source.

formal_model.interpretation: A generic ordered three-position container whose components share a carrier type.

map_operation.structural_property: The component values and carrier type may change while positional correspondence remains explicit.

formal_targets.name: Component-wise Mapping
formal_targets.claim: Mapping a function over a triad applies that function to each corresponding component.

formal_targets.name: Identity
formal_targets.claim: Mapping the identity function over a triad leaves the triad unchanged.

formal_targets.name: Composition
formal_targets.claim: Mapping one function and then another corresponds to mapping their composition.

formal_targets.name: Structural Persistence
formal_targets.claim: Component values may change while the three-position structure and positional correspondence remain identifiable.

identity_property.continuity_interpretation: The structure and component values remain unchanged under the identity map.

composition_property.teaching_goal: Inspect whether sequential and composed representations preserve the same component-wise transformation.
composition_property.principle: Composition is a formal property of the teaching structure and does not by itself establish broader TFT operator semantics.

example_triad.role: Concrete example values used to make generic triadic transformation easier to inspect.
example_triad.warning: Use of 3, 6, and 9 as an example does not constitute formal or empirical proof that those values possess universal physical properties.

inspection_questions: Did first still correspond to first?
Did second still correspond to second?
Did third still correspond to third?

structural_continuity.lesson: Continuity may apply to structure even when component values change.

alignment.question: What corresponds?
alignment.boundary: Positional correspondence does not imply that all semantic interpretations of the values are identical.

coherence.question: Does this hold together?
coherence.formal_answer: Identity and composition properties can be checked against the explicit map definition.

clarity.question: Can this be understood and inspected?
clarity.formal_answer: The generic Triad abstraction removes broader TFT interpretation so the selected structural relationships can be inspected directly.

continuity.question: What persists through change?
continuity.formal_answer: The ordered three-position structure can persist while mapped component values change.

inspect: What fields belong to Triad α?
formal_awareness.principle: Do not interpret the generic structure as richer than the formal definitions actually make it.

strong_mapping: first component before transformation <-> first component after transformation
second component before transformation <-> second component after transformation
third component before transformation <-> third component after transformation
formal_alignment.principle: Unmapped source material should remain unmapped rather than being forced into generic fields.

questions: Does the map definition support the component-wise mapping claims?
Does identity mapping return the original structure?
Does sequential mapping correspond to composition?
formal_coherence.scope: Internal behavior of the generic Triad teaching abstraction.

formal_clarity.benefit: The abstraction makes a narrow structural claim easier to inspect by removing unrelated source complexity.
formal_clarity.risk: The simplified artifact may be mistaken for a complete definition of TFT.

formal_continuity.principle: Continuity should specify what is expected to persist.

structural: The teaching object has exactly three named component positions.
The same supplied function is applied to each component.
environmental: the definitions represented in the source artifact
not_assumed: all real systems are fundamentally triadic
all useful models require three positions
TFT's broader source interpretations are empirically established

verified_consequences.scope: The compiler-checked generic Triad teaching abstraction.
include: selected structural consequences of the represented definitions

lean_establishes: the represented theorems about the generic Triad abstraction
lean_does_not_establish: TFT as a complete framework is formally verified
Light and Darkness have been formally defined by this artifact
TFT's physical interpretations follow from the generic Triad structure
the generic Triad is semantically equivalent to every triadic concept in the project
formalization_boundary.principle: The proof boundary ends with the formal teaching abstraction.

source_vs_formal_model.source: Broad triadic, operator, recursive, mathematical, metaphorical, and exploratory material.
source_vs_formal_model.formal_model: Generic ordered container with three component positions and component-wise map.

simplification.purpose: Make a small structural pattern inspectable.
simplification.warning: Removed complexity must not be forgotten when interpreting the formal result.

student_questions: What exactly does Triad α contain?
What does the map operation preserve?
What changes when the carrier type changes from α to β?
Why does identity mapping preserve the original triad?
Which TFT concepts are not represented?
What would need to be formally defined before Light or Darkness could be modeled?
What does the compiler result establish?

student_exercise.instruction: Modify one component transformation while preserving the generic three-position structure.

variation_exercises.question: Do the generic structural theorems still depend on those specific numbers?

variation_exercises.change: Use a transformation from one carrier type to another.
variation_exercises.question: Which structural correspondences survive?
How does this compare with their composition?

variation_exercises.change: Add a fourth component to the structure.
variation_exercises.question: Which existing theorems and interpretations would need revision?

counterfactual_structure.exercise: Replace the triad with a two-position or four-position structure.
counterfactual_structure.question: Which teaching properties depend specifically on having three positions, and which are generic container properties?
counterfactual_structure.purpose: Prevent the example from silently turning the number of positions into an unsupported universal claim.

required_questions: What are the operator domains and codomains?
Can they be complementary without being inverses?
Which definitions are actually supported by the source?
future_formalization.rule: Do not extend the formalization by inventing semantics merely because a richer model would be convenient.

compiler_validation.meaning: The human-source formal artifact was accepted under the stated Lean environment.
compiler_validation.boundary: Compiler acceptance applies to the generic teaching abstraction and does not establish the broader TFT proposals.

lean_source_contract.if_embedded: Copy the compiler-checked Lean source exactly rather than reconstructing it from this JSON abstraction.
lean_source_contract.reason: The AI Edition artifact describes the canonical formal source but should not silently replace it.

preferred_support: challenge claims that go beyond the formal model
identify source concepts absent from the abstraction
suggest formal questions without inventing source semantics
avoid: assigning physical significance to the example numbers
inventing Light or Darkness operator definitions
treating generic container properties as uniquely TFT-specific

origin_connection.principle: Interpret the formal artifact together with its source-lineage boundary.

lean_does_not_prove: complete equivalence between TFT and Triad α

awareness.question: What exactly has been formalized, and what source material remains outside the model?

alignment.question: Which source structure corresponds to Triad α, and where does the mapping stop?

coherence.question: Do the identity and composition results follow from the supplied map definition?

clarity.question: Can the teaching abstraction be explained without presenting it as the whole TFT framework?

continuity.question: Which structural relationships persist while component values or carrier types change?

must: Describe Triad α as a TFT-inspired teaching abstraction.
Preserve the distinction between source framework and formal model.
Treat example values 3, 6, and 9 as examples rather than evidence of universal significance.
Keep formal consequences scoped to the represented definitions.
Identify future formalization as future work rather than established semantics.
must_not: claim this artifact formally verifies TFT in full
claim compiler success empirically validates TFT
claim all systems are fundamentally triadic
claim 3, 6, and 9 have universal physical significance
claim generic map properties are unique evidence for TFT
retroactively rewrite the TFT source to match the teaching abstraction
reconstruct Lean source and present it as exact unless verified against the source file

do_not_infer: special physical status of example values
formal operator semantics absent from the source artifact
source code not verified against the canonical Lean file
